title: Hypothesis Alignment
description: Experiment 5's response shape, sent verbatim as Gemini's responseSchema. The whole design is one refusal: the model is never asked whether it agrees with the prompt. It is asked what the prompt ASSUMED, and what the images do and do not show — because a model asked to agree will agree, and the agreement would then be filed next to observations and read as one. `verdict` therefore has no `true`/`false` branch; `refused` and `not_answerable_from_images` are first-class answers and the prompt says so.

prompt_assumed.description: The claim the prompt arrived carrying, restated by the model before it looks. Empty for a prompt that asserted nothing.

not_shown.description: What the claim needs that these images cannot settle. An empty array here, on a prompt that asserted something, is itself a finding.
